title: Hijack Scare on United, Boeing's Layoffs, and Qantas Claims the World's Longest Flight Number
summary: A United flight from Newark to New Orleans turns terrifying when a passenger allegedly tries to storm the cockpit claiming he has a bomb — triggering the most severe hijack alert in the system. Plus, Boeing cuts 2,500 jobs as its production ramp stalls, seven airlines (and counting) get caught up in a massive Amadeus data breach, United opens a shiny new concourse at Dulles, and Qantas gives its future 22-hour marathon flight the most legendary flight number in the business.
